summary: Outlook Therapeutics filed an 8-K disclosing a public offering of 55,555,556 common shares with accompanying warrants at a combined price of $0.99 per unit, raising approximately $55.0 million gross. The warrants, exercisable immediately at $1.10 per share for five years, include a 4.99%/9.99%/19.99% ownership blocker. Underwriters Piper Sandler and BTIG exercised an option for 8,333,333 additional warrants. Closing is set for August 14, 2026. The offering is a capital raise under an existing S-3 shelf, not a buyback or dividend; classify as capital markets activity, not a special situation.
